apply: calibrate_heights.py apply reads the rows below (file, id): after the calibration of a raw file, a row listed under wikidata whose raw height_src is not osm / osm_part gets the Wikidata height and floors (height_src wikidata); a row listed under sibling (never osm / osm_part / wikidata) gets the sibling height and floors (height_src sibling). Rebuild this file with buildings/extra_heights.py build.

wikidata.source: Wikidata (CC0 1.0), https://query.wikidata.org/sparql, cached raw results in data/buildings/_wikidata/

details:
SELECT ?item ?c ?rank WHERE { VALUES ?item { %s }
  ?item p:P625 ?st . ?st ps:P625 ?c ; wikibase:rank ?rank . }

SELECT ?item ?st ?floors ?rank WHERE { VALUES ?item { %s }
  ?item p:P1101 ?st . ?st ps:P1101 ?floors ; wikibase:rank ?rank . }

SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?anc ?ancEn WHERE { VALUES ?item { %s }
  ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* ?anc . ?anc rdfs:label ?ancEn . FILTER(LANG(?ancEn) = "en") }

SELECT ?item ?ev ?evEn WHERE { VALUES ?item { %s }
  ?item wdt:P793 ?ev . OPTIONAL { ?ev rdfs:label ?evEn . FILTER(LANG(?evEn) = "en") } }

SELECT ?item ?alias WHERE { VALUES ?item { %s }
  ?item skos:altLabel ?alias . FILTER(LANG(?alias) IN ("vi", "en")) }

rules.value:
non-deprecated rank without an 'applies to part' qualifier, normalised to metres (psn; metre amounts as they are),
lower median. Floors: P1101 likewise. Then height = P2048, else floors x 3.3 + 4; floors = P1101, else
round(height / 3.3) (>= 1).
item: not a building class (P31/P279* Q41176), with or without floors
a label word in ['cruise', 'cruises', 'boat', 'ship', 'yacht', 'du thuyen'] (floating hotels)
P5817 state of use naming proposed/planned/construction/demolish/destroyed/former/abandoned/cancel/not in use/unfinished/unbuilt/disused
opened / inception after the map extract (2026-10-20)
rules.candidates: footprints of the raw layer within 50 m of the item point (distance to the footprint, 0 inside)
rules.score: 3 x name match (similarity >= 0.75 with the footprint's OSM name; name_sim: difflib ratio without generic words, 0.9 for whole-word containment) -1 if the footprint has an OSM name with similarity < 0.3 + 1 if it contains the point + 1 x size (log scale, 0 at 100 m2 .. 1 at 2000 m2) + 1 if its own raw height >= min(H / 2, 30 m) - distance / 25 m
rules.pick: highest score (ties: nearer, file, id); rejected if no candidate or best score < 0; runner-up within 0.25 and no name match: rejected as ambiguous; runner-up within 0.75: listed, best kept; two items on one footprint: the one with P2048 first, then higher score, then lower QID

plausibility.rule: height / sqrt(area) <= slender_max (p99.5 of clean OSM rows >= 30 m); with a raw 2.5D value: height / h25 within the cap [0.5, 4.0] (tall-stage alpha clamp; upper bound off for h25 >= 94 m) and within the p1-p99 range of real / h25 of clean OSM rows in the real-height band of the claim; without a raw 2.5D value: only name matches, height <= p99 of real heights of clean no-2.5D OSM rows
plausibility.why_cap: the percentile band alone let 363 m on h25 42.6 m (8.5x) through: the >= 150 m band holds only 64 tagged towers, which 2.5D under-reads up to 13.8x (p99), so the band limit was 13.77

rules.name_conflict: the best footprint has an OSM name with similarity < 0.5 to every vi / en label or alias: rejected
rules.unbuilt: P31/P279* ancestor label containing ['proposed building', 'proposed structure', 'planned building', 'planned structure', 'under construction', 'unbuilt', 'unfinished building', 'unfinished structure', 'cancelled', 'canceled', 'never built', 'demolished building', 'demolished structure', 'destroyed building', 'former building', 'lost building', 'ruins']; P5817 label containing ['proposed', 'planned', 'construction', 'demolish', 'destroyed', 'former', 'abandoned', 'cancel', 'not in use', 'unfinished', 'unbuilt', 'disused']; P793 event containing ['demolition', 'destruction', 'cancel', 'abandon']; P576 present
rules.never_overrides: osm, osm_part (disagreements are reported, not changed)

rules.targets: rows without a real height (not osm / osm_part / wikidata) with raw h25 >= 25 m or footprint >= 400 m2
rules.sources: osm / osm_part rows that are not junk and not in a mass-tagged block (calibrate_heights truth filters), and applied Wikidata rows
rules.candidate: within 300 m (centroids), area ratio in [0.75, 1.25], long side and elongation ratios in [0.8, 1.25]
rules.link: same indexed name stem (CT1/CT2, Toa A/Toa B, Block 3/Block 4; the letters of the index stay in the stem), the same full OSM name, the same smallest OSM complex area (landuse residential/commercial/retail, residential=*, amenity university/college/hospital/school, <= 0.5 km2, holding the centroid) or the same type=site relation
rules.vote: Siblings (source index, link) of a target with raw h25 `th` that may vote. The source must pass source_ok. Target with a raw h25 (>= 2 m): the sibling's raw h25, or its real height when it has no raw h25, within [1 / factor, factor] of th (both >= SIB_SAT_SIMILAR: similar); a link by complex area / site only (no name) also needs th >= SIB_COMPLEX_H25_MIN. Target without a raw h25: only siblings linked by name (name stem / same name).
rules.value: median of the qualifying siblings' heights; floors: lower median of their floors

selection.criterion: LOO MAE over eligible training-block calibration rows, siblings from training-side sources only (rows without a sibling keep the current value)

leave_one_out.rows: calibration rows (clean OSM, with a 2.5D value) meeting the target rule, each predicted from its siblings without itself
leave_one_out.current: out-of-sample value of the published model (inner block CV for training rows, hold-out for held-out rows)

holdout.note: before = the published model (main + tall stage) on the 2 km block hold-out of calibrate_heights; after = Wikidata where an accepted item matches the row, else a sibling copy from training-side real heights (osm / osm_part rows outside the held-out blocks, applied Wikidata rows), else before
